messages:
mae: Quick flag — new quant-bridge v1 promoted to 5% this morning. Small but consistent drop in concordance on legal longform slice (seqlen>2k). dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/r/qbridge
sahil: saw that. delta_concordance -0.018, hallucination +1.1pp concentrated on route=legal_long.
tom: any token corruption evidence or just distributional mismatch?
lee: sampled outputs show a pattern: extra negation in conclusions. no token corruption.
mae: propose tight canary-rule: scope to slice tag `route:legal_long`, trigger auto-fallback at hallucination_delta >= +0.9pp over 3x5m windows, action -> float16 replica. also run heavy-tail smoke N=80 (1k-3k) before re-enable.
ci-bot: noted: create smoke job 91234 queued. ETA ~8m.
sahil: i'll draft the rule and aim to deploy to staging for a 1h shadow run. if smoke fails, fallback automatically.
mae: thanks — assign rollback to tom. reconvene after smoke results. :thumbsup:
